title: Nika: The Five Days That Gave Birth to Hagia Sophia
summary: Recounts how, in January of the year five hundred thirty-two in Constantinople, the Blue and Green racing factions joined forces after a botched execution and burned the capital for five days; how Emperor Justinian, already preparing to abandon his throne and flee, was kept in place by Theodora's words; and how the revolt was brought to an end behind the closed gates of the Hippodrome. The episode reaches on to the new Hagia Sophia rising from the ashes of the burned city, and to an emperor whose power was never questioned again.
